chunk.content: The name 'albacore', normally used for Thunnus alalunga, is used by French speakers in the eastern Atlantic for yellowfin tuna (T. albacares).
chunk.source_quote: while in the eastern Atlantic "albacore" is used by francophones for the yellowfin tuna (T. albacares).

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2 Scombrids of the World (FAO Fisheries Synopsis No. 125)
